geometry_edits.rationale: Replace the generic bend with a section-aware operator so the mass can express a clearer public/upper hierarchy and a more readable roof/section.
A folded section is a bounded adjustment that can strengthen the building's sectional identity without abandoning the existing terraced datum.
Add a courtyard macro that preserves the hall/mass in ancestry while introducing a real public void at the root level.
Use a moderate margin so the void remains occupiable and not merely a clipped residual.
Open the void to the verified access side to align the ground response with the site contract.
Make the public void the new root so the access-aligned threshold becomes the dominant organizational controller while retaining the existing mass beneath it.

graph_edits.rationale: Retarget the dominant modifier from a simple bend to a more programmatic section-family operation so the mass can carry a clearer public threshold and upper hierarchy.
Use a folded section family to introduce a legible sectional break and stronger ground/upper contrast while preserving the dominant mass.
Add a courtyard/void as a new root-level public-space controller so the access edge can become a real threshold rather than a sealed frontage.
Size the void moderately so it reads as usable public ground space rather than a decorative subtraction.
Orient the public opening to the site access side in the program frame to activate the verified frontage.
Keep the existing mass legible while carving a meaningful access-adjacent opening into the lower body.

rationale: The candidate is a coherent single mass in all four views, with a readable terraced/bent dominant gesture and acceptable silhouette continuity. However, for the neighborhood_living brief it fails the core street-building contract: the verified access edge is answered by a sealed or nearly sealed base rather than a legible public threshold, court, undercut, or entry seam. The open-space figure is weak and mostly incidental, so the ground relation is not yet semantically convincing. The form also reads more like a stacked sculptural object than a compact capacity-aware mixed-use building with an active lower edge and clear public void. Because the program-specific ground/public invariants are not satisfied, it does not pass the hard program fit gate even though the overall mass is not visibly broken.

reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Stacked platform logic can support a compact mixed-use figure with a strong base and legible upper massing.
